ColorsPage.title: Colors
ColorsPage.description: The Marksheet palette: folder green, card stock, the three marks and one navy ink ramp.
ColorsPage.theme_description: Each swatch is painted from its token in context.colors, so it follows the light or dark theme; the contrast is measured against the color it is read with.
ColorsPage.ink_description: The only neutrals: every grey in the app is a step of this navy ramp.
ColorsPage.role_folder: The report card's cover: hero bands, the menu header and the lock screen.
ColorsPage.role_folder-deep: Inside the cover: footer band, pressed primary button, current menu item.
ColorsPage.role_folder-ink: Text and the inverse button on folder green.
ColorsPage.role_folder-ink-soft: Secondary text and resting nav items on folder green.
ColorsPage.role_primary: Filled buttons, focus and selection: folder green by day, a lighter green by night.
ColorsPage.role_pass: The passed tick, and nothing else.
ColorsPage.role_pen: Red pen: failed marks, errors and destructive actions only.
ColorsPage.role_paper: Desk card stock, the page background.
ColorsPage.role_paper-card: Card face: cards, dialogs and the paper surface.
ColorsPage.role_ply: The ply under every control, menu and dialog.

TypographyPage.title: Typography
TypographyPage.description: The Marksheet type scale: Libre Franklin for everything printed, Kalam for the hand that fills the form in.
TypographyPage.headings_description: Six heading styles cover the app and the marketing pages; tight, heavy and printed.
TypographyPage.sample_headline: Results you can read at a glance
TypographyPage.classes_description: A style is only a look: a Text in context.text.titleLarge is not announced as a heading. Wrap it in Semantics(header: true) when it starts a section, as PageHeader and DemoCard do.
TypographyPage.display_description: Heavier and larger, for the hero on folder green, the error pages and the totals.
TypographyPage.text_description: Lead, body and hint copy, the table text, the printed label, the button, chip and badge labels, code and the two handwritten roles.
TypographyPage.text_sample_lead: Keep every test result in one place and see how each subject is going, term after term.
TypographyPage.text_sample_body: Each result has a test name, a status, a score out of 100 and the date it was taken. Notes are optional.
TypographyPage.text_sample_hint: Use the name printed on the test paper.
TypographyPage.text_sample_hand_remark: A strong term. Keep reading every day.
TypographyPage.inline_description: TextSpan styles for the web app's common inline elements, kept within the ink ramp.
TypographyPage.inline_mark: Use a background color to <mark>highlight</mark> text.
TypographyPage.inline_del: This line of text is meant to be treated as deleted text.
TypographyPage.inline_s: This line of text is meant to be treated as no longer accurate.
TypographyPage.inline_ins: This line of text is meant to be treated as an addition to the document.
TypographyPage.inline_u: This line of text will render as underlined.
TypographyPage.inline_small: This line of text is meant to be treated as fine print.
TypographyPage.inline_strong: This line is rendered as bold text.
TypographyPage.inline_em: This line is rendered as italic text.
TypographyPage.dl_description: Terms are printed labels; they sit beside the description on wider screens. Long terms can use TextOverflow.ellipsis.
TypographyPage.dl_lists: A description list is perfect for defining terms.
TypographyPage.dl_marking_1: Each test is marked out of 100; 50 or more is a pass.
TypographyPage.dl_marking_2: Pending results do not count towards the totals.
TypographyPage.dl_retakes: A retake adds a new row and keeps the first result on the card.
TypographyPage.dl_truncated: When a term is too long for its column, it is cut with an ellipsis and its full text shows on long-press.
TypographyPage.dl_nested: A description list can sit inside another one.
